Live device E2E on Android emulator (emulator-5554, Pixel_4a AVD, Android 17): real phone login -> OTP start/verify against the live gateway/auth-service -> reached Home -> My Buildings screen

Bug found live: My Buildings/Properties/Invitations failed with 'service is temporarily unavailable' right after login (ApiClient in-memory token null) -- root-caused via instrumented debug build to a second ApiClient instance (GetX fenix-recreated the lazyPut singleton when the login route stack was cleared), fixed in user_app/lib/app/config/app_flavour.dart (Get.put(..., permanent: true) matching SessionExpiryNotifier's existing pattern), reverified live: My Buildings/Properties/Invitations now render 'No records to show.' correctly for a fresh user
git diff -- user_app/lib/app/config/app_flavour.dart: single, minimal fix; no other files changed

Added .gitattributes (*.sh text eol=lf): infra/docker/postgres/init/*.sh were getting CRLF on Windows checkouts (core.autocrlf=true) and breaking inside the postgres:alpine container ('/bin/bash^M: bad interpreter'); committed blobs were already LF, no renormalization needed

Needs verification on a machine/network that can reach quay.io, or a mirrored image.
IMPLEMENTATION.recommended_next_step: Commit the ApiClient permanence fix and .gitattributes; transition IMPLEMENTATION -> REVIEW for the F4 feature.

bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: ApiClient was Get.lazyPut(fenix: true) instead of permanent; GetX disposed and silently recreated it (fresh, tokenless) when the login route stack was cleared after OTP verify, so the first authenticated request after login on any screen failed with a generic 'temporarily unavailable' error.
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: Changed to Get.put(ApiClient(...), permanent: true), matching the existing SessionExpiryNotifier pattern in the same file.
bugs_found_and_fixed.verification: Reproduced live on-device before the fix (screenshot my_buildings.png), fixed, rebuilt, reproduced the full login -> My Buildings flow again live and confirmed correct empty-state rendering (my_buildings_fixed.png); full flutter verify suite still green after the fix (66/66).
